explanation.text:
See on Psa 4:1, title; Psa 32:1, title; for the history, see Sa1 23:19, Sa1 23:29; 1Sa. 26:1-25. After an earnest cry for help, the Psalmist promises praise in the assurance of a hearing. (Psa 54:1-7)

by thy name-- (Psa 5:11), specially, power.

judge me--as in Psa 7:8; Psa 26:1.

bsb.title: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. When the Ziphites went to Saul and said, “Is David not hiding among us?”
bsb.text: Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!

1.interlinear: Save/H3467 me O God/H430 by thy name/H8034 and judge/H1777 me by thy strength/H1369

bsb.text: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.

2.interlinear: Hear/H8085 my prayer/H8605 O God/H430 give ear/H238 to the words/H561 of my mouth/H6310

explanation.text:
strangers--perhaps Ziphites.

oppressors--literally, "terrible ones" (Isa 13:11; Isa 25:3). Such were Saul and his army.

not set . . . them--acted as atheists, without God's fear (compare Psa 16:8).

bsb.text: For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life—men with no regard for God. Selah

3.interlinear: For strangers/H2114 are risen up/H6965 against me and oppressors/H6184 seek/H1245 after my soul/H5315 they have not set/H7760 God/H430 before them Selah/H5542

explanation.text:
(Compare Psa 30:10).

with them--on their side, and for me (compare Psa 46:11).

bsb.text: Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.

4.interlinear: Behold God/H430 *is mine helper/H5826 the Lord/H136 *is with them that uphold/H5564 my soul/H5315

explanation.text:
He shall . . . evil--or, "Evil shall return on" (Psa 7:16) my enemies or watchers, that is, to do me evil (Psa 6:7).

in thy truth--Thy verified promise.

bsb.text: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.

5.interlinear: He shall reward/H7725 evil/H7451 unto mine enemies/H8324 cut them off/H6789 in thy truth/H571

explanation.text: I will freely, etc.--or, present a freewill offering (Lev 7:16; Num 15:3).

bsb.text: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.

6.interlinear: I will freely/H5071 sacrifice/H2076 unto thee I will praise/H3034 thy name/H8034 O LORD/H3068 for *it *is good/H2896

explanation.text:
mine eye . . . desire--(compare Psa 59:10; Psa 112:8), expresses satisfaction in beholding the overthrow of his enemies as those of God, without implying any selfish or unholy feeling (compare Psa 52:6-7).
